title: Two Enemies Set The Whole Planet On Fire To Save It, And A Firefighter Led The Charge . . . (Promare)
caption:
Two enemies set the whole planet on fire to save it, and a loud firefighter led the charge. 🔥 Promare, the full story. Follow for more anime movie recaps!

#promare #anime #animemovie #animerecap #animeexplained
comment: Would you have forgiven Lio after everything his gang burned down? Why?

segments.say: To stop a dying Earth, a firefighter and his sworn enemy set the whole planet *ablaze*.
To see how it got here, go back to the day the world first *burned*.
Ordinary people burst into flames, and in one night half of humanity was *gone*.
Some survivors could burn on purpose. People called them Burnish, and the world turned on *them*.
Thirty years later, a loud rookie firefighter named *Galo* runs straight into burning buildings.
His team, Burning Rescue, puts out fires that no regular crew can *touch*.
Their enemy is Mad Burnish, a gang of fire terrorists, led by a cold young man named *Lio*.
When they torch a skyscraper, Galo throws himself in, but his heavy gear can't keep *up*.
So his friend Lucia sends over a brand new suit, and it looks completely *ridiculous*.
Galo stops mid-fight to strike a heroic pose, and he gets *blasted*.
Classic Galo. Zero plan, all *heart*.
Then Lio steps out of the fire, and the two of them finally fight one on *one*.

segments.text: The only thing that should be burning is your soul.

segments.say: Galo takes the beating, and then his whole crew shows up and freezes Lio *solid*.
But the Freeze Force storms in, and its boss, Vulcan, tries to arrest *Galo*.
Lio gets dragged off to prison, and the whole city thinks the war is *over*.
Galo gets a medal from Governor Kray, the man who once pulled him out of a fire, then celebrates over *pizza*.
But the Freeze Force bursts in, drags out the Burnish cook, and arrests the old owner for hiding *him*.
Meanwhile, Lio's gang tears open the prison truck and breaks *free*.
Shaken, Galo rides to a frozen lake in the mountains, and Aina follows *him*.
Then a Burnish flame lights up the woods, and he finds Lio's gang hiding in a cave with one of them *dying*.
Galo begs to help, but she dies anyway, and her body turns to *ashes*.
Lio says every Burnish turns to ash, and that Kray's foundation is killing them for *research*.
Galo calls him a liar. The governor would never do that. Lio just walks *away*.
So Galo storms into Kray's office with his medal in his hand and asks if it's *true*.
Kray does not deny a single word. He just says, *follow me*.
Deep underground, Kray shows him the real problem. In six months, the magma will bury the whole *planet*.
His answer is a giant spaceship with only ten thousand seats. Everyone else gets *left behind*.
And the engine runs on Burnish. Galo watches the pizza cook scream inside a *pod*.
Galo loses it and says he will put out the magma himself, and Kray has him thrown in a *cell*.
Kray was never the hero Galo *thought*.
Meanwhile, the Freeze Force follows the old pizza man's hidden tracker straight to Lio's *hideout*.
Vulcan freezes Lio's whole gang with absolute zero bullets, one by *one*.
Then he blasts Lio into the crater of a volcano. Nobody could survive *that*.
But a single spark was still *burning*.
A week later, nobody has seen Galo. His friends hear he's been arrested as a *terrorist*.
His only visitor is Heris, Aina's big sister, and she looks *guilty*.
Galo asks if Aina knows what the ship runs on. Heris says she will do anything to keep her sister *alive*.
Saving her sister, she was dooming everyone *else*.
Then fire explodes across the city, and a voice demands every Burnish be freed. It is Lio, back from the *dead*.
Galo escapes his cell, charges the fire dragon with his crew, and laughs, because the flames feel barely *warm*.
Their fight smashes through the ice into a hidden vault, and a computer calls them by *name*.
It's Professor Deus, a scientist who built every weapon against the Burnish, until Kray had him *killed*.
He reveals the secret behind the flames. They are alive, a fire lifeform from another universe called the *Promare*.
Whenever Kray burns a Burnish for power, the Promare feel the pain, and the planet's core will *explode*.
So Deus hands them his own weapon, a giant machine that two pilots can run *together*.
Lio hates the idea of fighting beside a firefighter. Galo just says, if there's a fire, I put it *out*.
They launch in a giant mech called Leo de Galan, and Galo's burning soul finally *wakes up*.
Kray answers with his own white robot, and its cannon freezes anything to absolute *zero*.
Galo does not even dodge. He just grins and takes it *head on*.
Then Kray *laughed*.
He is a Burnish too, and he has hated Galo since the day they *met*.
He admits saving Galo was a complete accident, and he sent him to the deadliest job to get rid of *him*.

segments.text: I wanted to be rid of you, but you kept surviving.

segments.say: Kray locks Lio into his engine as a living power core, and the ship starts a five minute *countdown*.
Ignis and the whole team hold off Vulcan's troops, and Lucia fires Galo straight at the *engine*.
Inside, Galo finds Lio burning alive, and he grabs him and refuses to let *go*.
Lio wakes up. For the first time in his life, he lit a fire to save somebody *else*.
Lio says the Promare only need to burn out once, so he asks Galo to burn the whole planet *with him*.
Galo says yes, because he can put out a fire as big as the *world*.
Every Burnish on Earth lends them their flame, and their friends stand right beside *them*.
Galo and Lio become one giant machine, and the whole planet lights *up*.
Then everything goes quiet. The Promare are sent home, the Burnish are gone, and the city starts to *rebuild*.

segments.text: Yeah, I'm the universe's number one firefighting idiot.

segments.say: A firefighter and a terrorist saved the Earth by burning it, and they both walked away *smiling*.
